purpose: Machine-readable plan-level negative and positive scenarios for extending existing PO Instruction Authority / Plan Before Code. These are not executable results and DO NOT mark a guard as proven.
authorityRule: Canonical PO issue wins over historical summaries; later explicit PO decisions supersede earlier generic classification in its exact scope. Unverified source is not accepted as a fabricated subpoint. No automatic new PO decisions.
scopingNote: Run only in relevant business domain; no retroactive global blocking of doc-only or unrelated changes. SOURCE_UNKNOWN requires governed review; for safety-critical affected work, fail closed.
